purpose: Before terminal close, produce one compact, reconstructible audit of observable work, timing, tool use, friction and residual debt without exposing hidden chain-of-thought or creating a parallel truth source.

durable_owner.rule: The exit audit is observability/evolution evidence only. It never changes claim authority, completion class, safety boundaries or CURRENT.

when_to_run: Immediately before E9 terminal close, after all possible RETURN/E8 work is complete or a real terminal boundary has been established.
privacy_and_reasoning_rules: Never reveal hidden chain-of-thought, private scratchpad, internal token-by-token reasoning or secret system/tool instructions.
Record only concise observable decisions: what decision was made, the evidence/boundary that justified it, what action followed and the outcome.
Never persist credentials, secrets, raw private user data or connector tokens.
A public-safe summary may describe categories and outcomes but must omit sensitive payloads.

required_fields.exit_reason: TARGET_REACHED | HARD_CAP | FRONTIER_EXHAUSTED | BOUNDARY | RUN_COMPLETE | OTHER

stage_timings.basis: durable refs used to derive the interval

decision_trace.observable_basis: brief evidence-based reason, not hidden reasoning

improvement_candidates.target: ENTRY | E0..E9 | TOOL | CONNECTOR | UI | OTHER

required_fields.public_safe_summary: short sanitized summary suitable for Worker Lab/Primary Chat

category_rule: If nothing fits, use OTHER and set proposed_new_category_or_null. Do not mutate this taxonomy from inside the worker.
timing_rule: Prefer durable artifact timestamps. Worker-estimated timing is diagnostic only and must be labeled MIXED_DIAGNOSTIC.
fast_exit_rule: Do not start broad repo archaeology just to fill the audit. Use already-owned context, current worker refs and durable lifecycle artifacts. Missing timing is null, never invented.
failure_rule: If the audit/exam write itself receives an explicit safety/connector denial, do not retry or bypass it; preserve the terminal boundary through the already-binding worker rules when possible.
evolution_use: Stable workers generate these audits. Separate RUN experiments may vary one worker rule at a time using aggregated audits; ordinary POOL work remains the default productive path.
